description: This file defines a class ExternalTypeGrain implementing the IExternalTypeGrain interface, with methods involving external types such as NameObjectCollectionBase and EnumClass. It is part of a test suite for grain implementations in the Orleans framework.

classes.name: ExternalTypeGrain
classes.description: A grain class implementing IExternalTypeGrain, providing methods involving external data types and logging.

methods.name: GetAbstractModel
methods.description: Asynchronously processes a list of NameObjectCollectionBase objects, logs a debug message.

methods.name: GetEnumModel
methods.description: Returns a task that produces an EnumClass with its EnumsList property initialized with DateTimeKind.Local.
